dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. Victoria and part of Esquimalt with detailed sketches and relief markings showing the land cover and some faint numbered plots of land. Very few buildings and roads included. Esquimalt Lagoon, Royal Bay, Portage Inet, Esquimalt Harbour, Village Bay, Victoria Harbour, James Bay, Clover Point, Foul Bay, Trial Island, Gonzales Point, Oak Bay, Cadboro Bay, Cordova Bay, and the original boundary of the Hudson Bay Company's Reserve are all features that are named on the map.
